items.en: In your opinion, what defines a true leader?

items.uz: Menimcha, bu o'z xatolarini tan olish qobiliyati.
items.en: In my opinion, it's the ability to admit one's mistakes.

items.uz: U hech qachon o'zini boshqalardan ustun qo'ymagan shekilli.
items.en: It seems he/she has never placed himself/herself above others.

items.uz: Ha, va bu uning eng katta kuchi edi.
items.en: Yes, and that was his/her greatest strength.

items.uz: Qiyin damlarda qanday qaror qabul qilgan?
items.en: How did he/she make decisions in difficult moments?

items.uz: Jamoasini tinglab, keyin qat'iy harakat qilgan.
items.en: He/she listened to his/her team, then acted decisively.

items.uz: Har doim emas, ammo ishonchni mustahkamlaydi.
items.en: Not always, but it strengthens trust.
What advice would you give to young leaders?

items.uz: Kamtar bo'ling va doim o'rganishga tayyor turing.
items.en: Be humble and always be ready to learn.
This is wonderful advice, thank you.
I express my thanks for the conversation.
